title: Say Ag-ontutundan Pasyente
intro: Diad saray awaran na propesiya, pigpigara so nansungdo ed ontan lan inkaandi tan pisikal a kairapan tekep na agnagiing a pananisia. Say istorya na sayan pigura et sakey ya ag-onsaew a leksion ed anos tan panagmatalek ed madibinon kakabatan. Siopa iyan kamarerwa?
clues: Pinili ak nen Allah ya mangiter na mensahe, balet say sankabalgan ya subok ed siak et aliwan diad impangipulisay ed siak, noagta diad personal a kalamidad.
Nantutumbokan ya inala ray kayamanan ko, saray ayayep ko, tan saray anak ko.
Napno na sugat so laman ko, tan bukbukor ko nilikud ed suporta na asawak.
Tinmawag ak ed Katawan ko, ya binidbir ko so paniirap ko tan inanap koy panangasi To.
Siak so binilin ya igatin-gatin so salik ed dalin, tan pinmaway so makaparepreskon subol.
Inpawil nen Allah so bunigas ko tan inikdan to ak na balon pamilya tan mas dakel ni so kayamanan ko nen say dati.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say inkasian ed pamilya tan inlako ed aripen
Nasubok ed sakey a balitok a kilaw a baka

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Sakey a biong a gawad kiew
Sakey a tinunaw a kilaw a baka

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say pakaliktar ed sakey a balyena
Say pangawat na anak a laki ed itatatken

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
